translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Matande puha ia Puang Yesus anna la Musa
Dadi, inggannakoa' solasubungku umma'na Puang Allataala to puham duka' natambai, penabaam manappa siaia' too diona Puang Yesus to taakui taua Suhona Puang Allataala anna Sando Too'.

Manuhu' si'da-si'da lako Puang Allataala to untuhoi, susi Musa yolona manuhu' si'da-si'da umpalako pengkähänganna illaam banuanna Puang Allataala, battu diua illaam alla'-alla'na umma'na Puang Allataala.
Sapo' sihatam anna sipäto' dipa'kasallei puha ia Puang Yesus anna la Musa, umba susi dipa'kasallei puha ia to umpake'de' banua anna la indo banua napake'de'.
Abana ingganna banua deem to umpake'de'i. Sapo' to umpapia ingganna-ingganna sia Puang Allataala ia.

Indo ia Musa manuhu' umpalako pengkähänganna illaam alla'-alla'na umma'na Puang Allataala sihhapam mesa sabua' manuhu' umpalako pengkähänganna illaam banuanna puäna. Anna ingganna indo napogau' Musa umpa'paissangam loppo' indo la natula' Puang Allataala illaam allo la ditingngajona.

Sapo' Kristus Ia Änä'na Puang Allataala to manontom ungkapalai banuanna Puang Allataala. Menna diuaam banuanna Puang Allataala? Kitaa' diuaam, ke tontä liui matoho penabanta anna ponno pahhannuam muampai indo tapemmitai la nabeengkia' Puang Allataala.
Kamalubeam nadandi Puang Allataala lako to matappa'
Iam too anna la untuhu'inna' inde tula'na Penaba Maseho naua:

content.text: “Maka' uhhingngikoa' kadanna Puang Allataala inde allo temo,
daa ungkahha' ulua' indana susikoa' nene to umponene kahha' ulu
anna umpa'sändä'i Puang Allataala dio pohiallasam.
‘Eta too napa'sändä'iä' nene to umponene anna napangngitaiä',
moi kela daa puham naita pa'pogausangku lako kalena appa' pulo taunna masäena.
Iam too umpakende' aha'ku lako tau ia too
Tä' ia la kupäbäi landa' lako indo pellubeam la kubeem.’”

content: O inggannakoa' solasubungku, jagai manappaia' indana deengkoa' ma'penaba kadake anna tä' matappa' lambi' umpemboko'i Puang Allataala Debata tubo.

Sapo' la allo-allo hakoa' ia sipakilala mesa sola mesa, sumala deempi wattu umba susi indo puha tisuha' illaam Battakada Debata naua: “Inde allo temo.” Iam too anna kuuaammokoa' aka kuua indana deennia' solamu nababa bulim dosa lambi' kahha' ulu.
Aka kitanna' too to sakalebu Kristus ke tontä liukia' matappa' sola ponno penaba umba susi kamanontonganna kamatappasanta pahandu'na.
Umba susi indo natula' illaam Battakada Debata ingngena' naua:

content.text: “Maka' uhhingngikoa' kadanna Puang Allataala inde allo temo,
daa ungkahha' ulua' indana susikoa' nene to umponene kahha' ulu

content: Iya menna diuaam to uhhingngi kadanna Puang Allataala sapo' moka untuhu'i? Lako ingganna hupatau to napatette Musa messubum illaam mai lembäna Mesir.
Anna menna diuaam to nahua aha'na Puang Allataala appa' pulo taunna masäena? Lako indo to madosa lambi' mate dio pohiallasam.
Ma'pinda Puang Allataala naua: “Tä' ia la kupäbäi landa' lako indo pellubeam la kubeem.” Iya menna nauaam? Tä' mala tala indo to moka manuhu' dio olona wattu eta too.
Dadi mannassa anna taissannia' tentomai taua tä' mala la landa' lako indo pellubeam la nabeem aka tä' matappa'.
